# BJP Tamil Nadu Local Body Candidate Application Portal 2026

> Official candidate application portal for BJP local body elections in Tamil Nadu.

## Information and Portals
- [Candidate Application](https://bjp-local-body.vercel.app/candidate-registration): 12-Step candidate registration portal
- [Admin Portal](https://bjp-local-body.vercel.app/admin): Leadership application review portal

## Core Features
- Mobile OTP Verification
- EPIC Voter ID Lookup
- Candidate Ward and Position Selection
